page.notes: The text runs over the lower margin and the hyphenated word "Groningan-nis" breaks across the column. Printing and reading doubts: a dot stands before "de" in the first line of the italic passage and is probably a speck. "cccc.LXXXVI I." is printed with a space and may be meant as LXXXVII. "præfecto" is uncertain because the letters are blurred. "XV I II" is printed with spaces and may be meant as XVIII. The Quadriennio line reads "xc I." as printed. The digitiser's watermark at the lower right is left out.
